title: 第20章 噬脉散第21章 天机
content_zh:
方天正沉默了很久。
“他做错了事。”老人家最终说道:“做错事就要付出代价。”
“他背后应该还有人。”
“我知道。”
“那个人，就是大长老你吗？”
静室里的空气仿佛凝固了。
方天正看着方圆，方圆也看着他。
两个人对视了整整十个呼吸的时间。
最后方天正笑了。
那是一个苦涩的笑，甚至还带着一点荒谬。
嘴角扯动了一下，然后迅速消失。
像一颗石子投入水中激起的涟漪，转瞬即逝。
“不是我。”方天正说。
“那是谁？”
“我不能说。”
“为什么？”
方天正掀起自己的右手袖子。
在他的右手小臂上，有一个黑色的印记。
和方正林、方安舌根下面的灭口蛊印记一模一样。
“我体内也有蛊。”

方天正放下袖子道:“两年前，有人在我茶里下了毒。
不是蛊，是另一种毒。
他告诉我，如果我泄露他的身份，毒就会发作。
不是毒死我，而是让我生不如死。
经脉寸断，修为尽废，瘫痪在床，眼睁睁看着自己的身体一天天腐烂。”
他顿了顿，声音低了下去。
“我不怕死。
但我怕变成那样。
一个武者，连自杀的力气都没有，只能躺在那里等死。
那比死更可怕。”
感受过曾经那样的活力，再面对这样无力的现实，没有人会受得了。
所以方圆沉默。
而且他前世见过那种毒。名为“噬脉散”，发作之后确实如方天正所说——经脉寸断，修为尽废，全身瘫痪，神智清醒地感受着自己的身体慢慢腐烂。
这是这个世界上最残忍的毒药。
“大长老，那个人是谁，你不知道？”
“我知道。”方天正苦笑，“但我不能告诉你。不是我不想，是我不能。只要我在脑海中浮现出他的名字、他的样貌、他的任何信息，噬脉散的‘禁制’就会触发——不需要我说出口，只要我想，毒就会发作。”
方圆的眼神变得更加深邃。
这种禁制，比灭口蛊更高明。灭口蛊是在人说出关键词之后才触发，而噬脉散的禁制是在人“想”到关键词的时候就触发。
这意味着，方天正的记忆被那个人用毒药“锁”住了。他记得那个人是谁，但他不能想，不能回忆，不能提起。
一旦想了，他就会生不如死。

“大长老，你不必说出他的名字。”方圆站起来，“你只需要做一件事。”
“什么事？”
“把你的家主印章借我用一下。”
方天正愣了一下：“家主印章？我没有家主印章。方家只有家主方正阳才有真正的家主印章。我的印章是长老印章，和家主印章不一样。”
content_en:
Fang Tianzheng was silent for a long time.
"He did something wrong." The old man finally said, "If you do something wrong, you have to pay the price."
"There should be someone behind him."
"I know."
"Is that person you, the Great Elder?"
The air in the quiet room seemed to freeze.
Fang Tianzheng looked at Fangyuan, and Fangyuan also looked at him.
The two people looked at each other for ten breaths.
Finally Fang Tianzheng smiled.
It was a bitter smile, even a little ridiculous.
The corners of his mouth twitched for a moment, then disappeared quickly.
Like the ripples caused by a stone thrown into water, it is fleeting.
"It's not me." Fang Tianzheng said.
"Who is that?"
"I can't say."
"Why?"
Fang Tianzheng lifted up his right sleeve.
On his right forearm, there was a black mark.
It was exactly the same as the mouth-killing Gu mark on the base of Fang Zhenglin and Fang An's tongue.
"There is also a poison in my body."
Fang Tianzheng put down his sleeves and said, "Two years ago, someone poisoned my tea.
It's not a poison, it's another kind of poison.
He told me that if I revealed his identity, the poison would kick in.
Not to poison me to death, but to make my life worse than death.
My meridians were cut off, my cultivation was ruined, I was paralyzed in bed, and I watched my body rot day by day. "
He paused and his voice lowered.
"I'm not afraid of death.
But I'm afraid it will become like that.
A warrior who doesn't even have the strength to commit suicide can only lie there and wait for death.
That's more terrible than death. "
No one can bear to face such a powerless reality after feeling the vitality they once had.
So Fangyuan was silent.
And he had seen that kind of poison in his previous life. It was called "Maiye Powder", and after the attack, it was exactly as Fang Tianzheng said - the meridians were cut off, the cultivation level was completely ruined, the whole body was paralyzed, and he was conscious and felt that his body was slowly decaying.
This is the cruelest poison in the world.
"Great Elder, you don't know who that person is?"
"I know." Fang Tianzheng smiled bitterly, "But I can't tell you. It's not that I don't want to, it's that I can't. As long as his name, his appearance, and any information about him appear in my mind, the 'restriction' of the Vein Vein Powder will be triggered - I don't need to say it, as long as I think about it, the poison will take effect."
Fangyuan's eyes became deeper.
This kind of restriction is more advanced than the mouth-killing Gu. The mouth-killing Gu is triggered after the person says the keyword, while the restriction of the Yanmai Powder is triggered when the person "thinks" of the keyword.
This means that Fang Tianzheng's memory was "locked" by that person with poison. He remembered who that person was, but he couldn't think about it, couldn't recall it, couldn't mention it.
Once he thinks about it, his life will be worse than death.
"Great Elder, you don't have to say his name." Fangyuan stood up, "You only need to do one thing."
"What's the matter?"
"Lend me your family head's seal."
Fang Tianzheng was stunned for a moment: "Family head's seal? I don't have the family head's seal. Only the head of the Fang family, Fang Zhengyang, has the real family head's seal. My seal is the elder's seal, which is different from the family head's seal."
